sofa.definition: A padded seat for more than one person.

armchair.definition: A chair with supports for the arms.
armchair.exampleUsage: The guest sits in the armchair.

coffee-table.definition: A low table usually placed in front of a sofa.
coffee-table.exampleUsage: Drinks are on the coffee table.

side-table.definition: A small table beside a seat or another piece of furniture.
side-table.exampleUsage: The side table holds a lamp.

ottoman.definition: A padded seat or footstool without a back or arms.
ottoman.exampleUsage: The ottoman is beside the sofa.

rocking-chair.definition: A chair supported on curved runners so it can rock.
rocking-chair.exampleUsage: The rocking chair is near the window.

dining-table.definition: A table used for eating meals.
dining-table.exampleUsage: The meal is on the dining table.

dining-chair.definition: A chair used at a dining table.
dining-chair.exampleUsage: The dining chair is beside the table.

bench.definition: A long seat for more than one person.
bench.exampleUsage: Two adults sit on the bench.

stool.definition: A seat without a back in this context.
stool.exampleUsage: The stool is beside the bookshelf.

bookshelf.definition: A shelf or set of shelves for books.

tv-stand.definition: Furniture used to support a television.
tv-stand.exampleUsage: The television is on the TV stand.

sideboard.definition: A piece of furniture for storing tableware and serving items.

shelf.definition: A horizontal surface used to hold items.

drawer.definition: A sliding storage compartment in furniture.
drawer.exampleUsage: The keys are in the drawer.

magazine-rack.exampleUsage: Magazines are in the magazine rack.

display-case.definition: A cabinet or container for showing objects.

coat-rack.definition: A stand or set of hooks for hanging coats.
coat-rack.exampleUsage: The coat is on the coat rack.

shoe-rack.definition: A stand or shelves for storing shoes.
shoe-rack.exampleUsage: The shoes are on the shoe rack.

television.definition: A device for receiving and showing video programmes.

remote-control.definition: A device for operating equipment from a distance.
remote-control.exampleUsage: The remote control is beside the sofa.

speaker.exampleUsage: The speaker is beside the television.

game-console.definition: A device used to play video games.
game-console.exampleUsage: The game console is on the shelf.

dvd-player.exampleUsage: The DVD player is under the television.

sound-bar.definition: A long narrow loudspeaker unit, often used with a television.
sound-bar.exampleUsage: The sound bar is below the screen.

wi-fi-router.definition: A device that routes network data and provides Wi-Fi access.
wi-fi-router.exampleUsage: The Wi-Fi router is on a clear shelf.

power-strip.definition: A device with several electrical sockets supplied through one cord.

cable.definition: A covered wire or group of wires carrying power or signals.
cable.exampleUsage: The cable runs behind the stand.

plug.definition: A fitting used to connect equipment to an electrical socket.

floor-lamp.definition: A tall lamp that stands on the floor.
floor-lamp.exampleUsage: The floor lamp is beside the sofa.

table-lamp.definition: A lamp placed on a table.
table-lamp.exampleUsage: The table lamp is on the side table.

ceiling-light.definition: A light fixture attached to the ceiling.

chandelier.definition: A hanging decorative light fixture with several lamps.
chandelier.exampleUsage: The chandelier hangs above the dining table.

light-bulb.definition: A replaceable device that produces light in a fixture.
light-bulb.exampleUsage: The unused light bulb is in its box.

candle.definition: Wax with a wick that can burn to provide light.

candle-holder.definition: A support intended to hold a candle.
candle-holder.exampleUsage: The candle is in the candle holder.

string-lights.definition: Small lights attached along a wire for decoration.
string-lights.exampleUsage: The string lights are stored in a box.

picture-frame.definition: A border or support for a picture.
picture-frame.exampleUsage: The picture frame stands on the shelf.

wall-clock.definition: A clock designed to hang on a wall.
wall-clock.exampleUsage: The wall clock hangs above the shelf.

cushion.definition: A soft padded item for comfort or decoration.
cushion.exampleUsage: The cushion is on the sofa.

throw-blanket.definition: A small blanket used on a sofa or chair.
throw-blanket.exampleUsage: The throw blanket is folded on the sofa.

rug.definition: A movable floor covering, usually smaller than the floor.
rug.exampleUsage: The rug is below the coffee table.

carpet.definition: A textile floor covering, here fitted across the room floor.

curtain.definition: A hanging cloth used to cover a window.

tablecloth.exampleUsage: The tablecloth covers the dining table.

placemat.definition: A small mat placed under one person’s table setting.
placemat.exampleUsage: The plate rests on a placemat.

coaster.definition: A small mat or stand placed under a drink.
coaster.exampleUsage: The glass rests on a coaster.

doormat.definition: A mat at an entrance for wiping shoes.
doormat.exampleUsage: The doormat is by the entrance.

tapestry.definition: A decorative woven textile, often hung on a wall.
tapestry.exampleUsage: The tapestry hangs on the wall.

plant.definition: A living plant kept indoors in this context.
plant.exampleUsage: The plant is near the window.

photo-frame.definition: A frame used to hold a photograph.
photo-frame.exampleUsage: The photo frame is beside the vase.

painting.exampleUsage: The painting hangs above the sofa.

book.definition: A bound or electronic work containing text or pictures.
book.exampleUsage: The book is on the table.

magazine.definition: A publication issued regularly with articles and pictures.
magazine.exampleUsage: The magazine is in the rack.

newspaper.definition: A publication containing news and other articles.
newspaper.exampleUsage: The newspaper is folded on the table.

board-game.definition: A game played with a board and often counters or pieces.
board-game.exampleUsage: The friends choose a board game.

puzzle.definition: A problem or game requiring a solution; here a jigsaw puzzle.

playing-cards.definition: A set of cards used for card games.
playing-cards.exampleUsage: The playing cards are in a box.

phone.definition: A device for calls and communication.
phone.exampleUsage: The phone is on the side table.

tablet.definition: A portable touchscreen computer in this context.
tablet.exampleUsage: The tablet is beside the phone.

charger.definition: A device supplying energy to a rechargeable battery.
charger.exampleUsage: The charger is on the desk.

headphones.definition: Devices worn over or in the ears for listening to sound.
headphones.exampleUsage: The headphones are beside the book.

watch-tv.definition: To look at programmes shown on a television.

read-a-book.definition: To read the text of a book.
read-a-book.exampleUsage: I read a book in the evening.

listen-to-music.definition: To pay attention to music that is playing.
listen-to-music.exampleUsage: I listen to music at home.

relax.definition: To rest or become less tense.

sit-down.definition: To move into a sitting position.

take-a-nap.definition: To have a short sleep, often during the day.
take-a-nap.exampleUsage: I take a nap on a free afternoon.
